heroLede: Whichever island you're posted on, membership gives you free case representation, a direct say in national bargaining, and access to CPD and scholarships.
feeNote: MVR 100 per month, plus a one-time MVR 100 joining fee at sign-up — the same rate for every profession.
ticker: FREE CASE REPRESENTATION FOR ALL MEMBERS
declarationText: I, the undersigned, apply for membership of the MHPU and declare that the foregoing statements are correct. I wish to join MHPU subject to the rule and constitution of the Union. I hereby undertake, if accepted as a member, to abide the rules of the Union and use my best endeavours to promote its objectives and interests.
